mapper.select: SELECT c.category_id, c.bbs_master_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.sort_order, c.use_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_article a WHERE a.category_id = c.category_id AND a.delete_yn = 'N') AS article_count FROM tb_bbs_category c WHERE c.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND c.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.category_code
SELECT category_id, bbs_master_id, category_code, category_name, sort_order, use_yn FROM tb_bbs_category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_article WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_category (category_id, bbs_master_id, category_code, category_name, sort_order, use_yn, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{bbsMasterId}, #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_category SET category_code = #{categoryCode}, category_name = #{categoryName}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_category SET delete_yn = 'Y', use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
